items.title: Nuclear aur particle physics: ta'aruf (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening (PDF 138, printed 134).

blocks.text: 1911 mein Ernest Rutherford ke tajurbon se pata chala ke atom ke beech mein ek bohat chhota, ghana (dense) aur positive charge wala hissa hai, jise nucleus kehte hain, aur us ke gird electrons hain. 1920 mein Rutherford ne kaha ke nucleus ka positive charge protons ki wajah se hai, aur ek aise particle ki peshgoi bhi ki jis par koi charge na ho. Yeh peshgoi 1932 mein sach sabit hui jab James Chadwick ne neutron daryaft kiya.

Nuclear physics atomic nuclei aur sub-atomic (atom se chhote) particles ke mukhtalif pehluon ka mutala hai. Is chapter mein hum khaas taur par yeh parhenge: ghair-mustahkam (unstable) nuclei jo radiation kharij karte hain, un ka decay (toot-phoot), aur fission aur fusion jaise nuclear reactions jo bohat zyada energy de kar insaniyat ko faida pohanchate hain. Mukhtalif elements ke radioactive isotopes tibbi tashkhees (diagnosis) aur ilaj, zaraat (agriculture), science ki tehqeeq aur sanat (industry) mein tracers ke taur par istemal hote hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: α-particles ke scattering (bikharne) wale tajurbon se Lord Rutherford ne nateeja nikala ke atom ka zyada tar hissa khali hai aur us ka mass ek bohat chhoti jagah mein jama hai jise nucleus kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Atom ke markaz mein chhota musbat nucleus (+), jis ke gird chaar aik doosre ko kaatte bayzawi (elliptical) madaron par aath manfi electrons hain; nucleus par 'Positive nucleus' likha hai.
blocks.caption: Kya aap jante hain? box: electrons se ghira musbat nucleus (kitab ke box ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Atomic nucleus ko symbol ᴬZX se likhte hain (A oopar, Z neeche, X ke baen taraf); ise aksar nuclide kehte hain. X element ka chemical symbol hai. Z atomic ya charge number hai jo protons ki tadaad batata hai. A mass number hai jo nucleons (protons + neutrons) ki kul tadaad batata hai. Nucleus mein neutrons ki tadaad N = A − Z hai. Is tarah hydrogen, carbon aur uranium ko ¹₁H, ¹²₆C aur ²³⁵₉₂U likhte hain. Nucleus bohat ghana hai aur us ka radius 10⁻¹⁴ m ke darje ka hai; us ke gird electrons ka badal (cloud) hai, aur atom ka radius 10⁻¹⁰ m ke darje ka hai, yani atom nucleus se taqreeban das hazar guna bara hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'cloud of elections' chhapti hai; murad electrons ka badal hai.

blocks.prompt: Uranium-235 (Z = 92) ke nucleus mein kitne protons aur neutrons hain?
blocks.explanation: 92 protons aur N = A − Z = 235 − 92 = 143 neutrons.

items: Nuclide ᴬZX: A = nucleons, Z = protons, N = A − Z.
Nucleus ka radius taqreeban 10⁻¹⁴ m; atom ka taqreeban 10⁻¹⁰ m.
